entities.name: Twelve Tribes of Israel
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The twelve tribal divisions of ancient Israel, descended from the twelve sons of Jacob. Each tribe was allocated territory in Canaan (except Levi, dedicated to priestly service). The tribal system defined Israelite identity, military organization, and worship practice from the settlement through the monarchy.
